sloka: दु:खाभितप्तो भरतो राजपुत्रो महाबल:।उक्त्वार्येति सकृद्दीनं पुनर्नोवाच किञ्चन ॥ २.९९.३८॥
transliteration: du:khābhitapto bharato rājaputro mahābala:।uktvāryeti sakṛddīnaṁ punarnovāca kiñcana ॥ 2.99.38॥

translations.english: Mighty prince Bharata, oppressed with grief, could only say, O Arya (venerable one) And in distress could not speak any more.
